title: Haslet
preamble:
Ingredients:-
8
oz stale white bread, cubed
1
medium onion, chopped
Milk
for soaking
1
teaspoon chopped fresh sage
2lb
lean pork, coarsely minced
Salt
and black pepper

oz stale white bread, cubed
1
medium onion, chopped
Milk
for soaking
1
teaspoon chopped fresh sage
2lb
lean pork, coarsely minced
Salt
and black pepper

Method:-
Soak the bread and squeeze out moisture
Oven on Gas Mark 5
Mix together and mince finely
Grease 2 and 1/2 lb loaf tin Put in mixture and press down
Bake for 1 and 1/2 hours covered in foil
Cool a little before turning out and serve cold
